reading_rule: Complete selected scientific source values, with custody-only fields removed as documented. Author-state tokens remain dated source history; original later qualification governs scientific acceptance.

common.actual_scope: Each enumerated member is the exact native formal activity, value/predicate, semantic control and comparator already individually authored in analysis_r12 and analysis_r15. Its actual acceptance question is the stated conditional mathematical/software/model/calculation claim. No submission of that member artifact to a named framework requirement is part of this selected use.
common.forward: F041 supplies the permitted evidential/procedural role of formal-method evidence under a named applicable framework. In this exact member use, no such recognition/acceptance requirement is an input to the inference, and no recognition record is offered as its evidence. Recognition therefore supplies no identified partial premise, constraint or discriminator for the actual value/predicate calculation. This is not a conclusion from failure to prove the entire native property.
common.reverse: The member supplies a scientific predicate, model or computation criterion, but this selected use supplies no applicable framework edition/domain/requirement or submitted formal-evidence role. It therefore contributes no identified premise to the actual F041 recognition relation. Giving an arbitrary theorem an unprovided certification consumer would introduce a new use rather than establish this direction.
common.partial_input_inquiry: The inquiry considered record reuse/communication, changed evidence, artifact identity, proof interpretation, method-selection cost, authorization and normative acceptance as well as the central theorem/calculation. Actual named reuse/change/retirement and evidence-choice roles have already been retained for D46,D51,R029,R038,R039. This complement is not assigned from nominal engineering/physical/formal categories, titles, or absence of complete system assurance.
common.scientific_versus_recognition_axes: A valid local theorem or calculation can be used through ordinary review without certification paperwork. A recognized formal method can also yield a wrong intended statement or an invalid application if its scientific premises are absent. Neither fact makes recognition a needed input to every predicate. No general claim that assurance records are useless is made.
common.primary_scope: F041 is read at its actual native/current guard: name applicable edition, domain and actual requirement. Own SYN009 reads the initial specified portion of FAA AC20-115D (21 July 2017), including its optional means and recognition of DO333, without paid-standard clause access. SYN010 reads the recorded public AC20-148 component-reuse passages (7 December 2004). These support the previously named framework-role examples; they do not create a certification consumer for every D/R value.
common.authority_scope: Operating authorization, a stakeholder loss policy, authenticated protocol messages, valid credentials and institutional model pedigree are distinct from acceptance of submitted formal-method evidence under the F041 framework. Their appearances in native records were examined, not silently treated as framework-role matches.
common.reentry: Re-enter the affected direction when a particular member artifact is actually used to discharge a named applicable assurance requirement, when a permitted evidence substitution/reuse rule changes that consumer decision, or when an actual framework-driven cost/communication/acceptance obligation is shown. Specify the edition/domain/requirement and exact value/predicate/evidence link; do not infer detailed paid clauses from metadata.
common.cost_alternative: The existing adequate local theorem, direct calculation, ordinary type/test or exact retained evidence remains available. Framework paperwork has a real role and cost where the actual consumer requires it; no extra procedural gate is created for this study.
common.scope_limit: These are bounded nonmatches for the explicitly selected uses, not universal noninteraction or an exhaustive census of every industry/framework. Existing five material-target interfaces and all native properties remain intact.
common.execution: Own fully exposed analytical role inquiry over the previously read native records, source scopes and actual value interfaces. No new source access, compliance audit, certification assessment or scientific program execution.
